A young black woman with sickle cell disease (HbSS variant) presented with a 2-day history of visual loss in the left eye

support_spans: Visual acuity was 20/20 OD and 20/800 OS
abnormal retinal capillary bed across the macula, with increased intercapillary spacing and small areas of hypofluorescence nasal to the fovea
